notes:
Inbound SMB trial from product lead (CTO). Signed up self-serve 2025-01-10, got first API key same day. Very early integration: basic question/answer and product-search prototype. Low token counts after day 3. Rep opened conversation 2025-01-14. Found they spun up competitor playground (CloudPrompt) to test latency/cost. Quote from CTO: "Nice latency but we need predictable monthly spend — unsure what the unit cost looks like at 100k qps equivalent." Short, transactional team.

Key points: staggered rollout, want simple SDKs, low engineering bandwidth to integrate advanced routing. Concerned about model behavior consistency: wants minimal hallucination for product descriptions. Curious about caching/batching to lower costs.

Trial behavior: installed SDK in staging, health-check calls only. Two test endpoints hit, then nothing. No real traffic spikes. Identified that default timeout triggered in their Lambda tests (they use small memory functions). They replicated a few calls on CloudPrompt where costs seemed lower for small experiments.

Security: need SSO for admin dashboard later, audit logs for compliance with marketplace partners. Not asking for private deployment now — public cloud is fine.

Rep actions so far: quickstart guide sent 2025-01-11, cost-estimator worksheet 2025-01-13, canary config recipe for caching 2025-01-16. SE ran a short debug session 2025-01-21 (ff_2025-01-21_debug_9h). Offered $250 platform credit to encourage more test calls (emailed 2025-01-22). CTO acknowledged but asked to see latency benchmarks for their median payload size (payload: product title + attributes ~ 400 tokens).
